title: Case Study: Mountkirk Games — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes Mountkirk Games Global Real-Time Gaming Architecture: Global Anycast External ALB, GKE Autopilot Game Server fleets managed by Agones, Cloud Spanner for player profiles, and Pub/Sub + Dataflow telemetry pipelines.
routing_rationale: Mountkirk Games requires global low-latency multiplayer matchmaking, dynamic scaling to absorb millions of concurrent players during new game releases, and global consistency for game economies and leaderboards.

nodes.label: Global Mobile Gamers
nodes.detail: Millions of concurrent players connecting from North America, Europe, and Asia.

nodes.label: External Passthrough LB
nodes.detail: Terminates player UDP traffic at edge and routes to nearest regional cluster.

nodes.label: Agones Game Controller
nodes.detail: Allocates game session pods; marks pods as 'Allocated' so autoscaler will not terminate them.

nodes.label: Dedicated Game Server Pod
nodes.detail: Runs 60 FPS real-time match simulation for 100 players with sub-30ms tick rate.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Leaderboards
nodes.detail: Guarantees zero item duplication or currency race conditions across global players.

nodes.label: Pub/Sub Game Analytics
nodes.detail: Streams game event telemetry to Dataflow and BigQuery for anti-cheat detection.

steps.title: Low-Latency Ingress & Session Allocation
steps.action: Anycast routes players to local region; Agones allocates dedicated match server pod.
steps.why_traversal: Keeps network latency under 30ms while preventing pod eviction mid-game.

steps.title: Economy Persistence & Analytics Streaming
steps.action: Game server records loot to Cloud Spanner and streams match metrics to Pub/Sub.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents virtual currency duplication and feeds real-time anti-cheat analytics.

scenarios.label: Autoscaler Prematurely Terminates Active Game
scenarios.root_cause: Generic Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler was used instead of Agones custom controller.
scenarios.diverted_path: HPA terminated 50 active match pods during traffic dip, disconnecting 5,000 players.
scenarios.blast_radius: Player frustration and app store ratings drop.
scenarios.recovery: Always use Agones Fleet Autoscaler which respects 'Allocated' state and never kills active sessions.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
